confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and regional context, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation anchors, which are the least certain. The local currency is the convertible mark, pegged to the euro, so prices are roughly half of comparable euro-zone capitals. FX provenance is weak: I did not open the RBA F11.1 table. The 0.6955 value for 2026-10-15 comes from a search-result summary that attributes it to the RBA Exchange Rates page, and I could not verify it on rba.gov.au. Conflicting search summaries also gave a March 2026 RBA figure, and a third-party 0.6947 figure for 2026-10-16 is unverified and not used. Verify the FX value against the RBA F11.1 table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against mid-sized Balkan capitals with euro-pegged or euro-linked currencies and lower price levels than Western Europe, such as Skopje, Podgorica and Tirana, with Belgrade as a loose upper reference. Anchors reflect July 2026 tourist-season prices at ordinary venues.
